items.title: Danny Barker — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History

ctx.x: Said it’s a nice girl, come from . . . that business . . . she comes from a nice family. So that went along with that. They said, “I want you a little girl to meet.” Louis Barbarin’s wife, Marie Philip, Louis used to go to hang with her sister, Maria’s sister, and they came to visit her on a Sunday, and she’s fine, so they say, “Got a young man I want you to meet.” “Daniel,” they said. “Oh yeah, Daniel be nice for her.” The parents, the way they talk. They pick for you. So they send for me next Sunday or a couple…
gal, meet her. Yes.” That’s how that started. I courted her three years. 17 - 18, 18 - 19, 19 - 20.
